summary.title: close issue 101 items 2 and 3
summary.what: Dogfood and acceptance scorecards now include a compact returned-context metric (chars/bytes per case, plus batch p50/p95). The acceptance gate gained two hard public synthetic mirrors of the real dogfood FP/FN shapes from item 1: a later title restatement losing to an executed path-like command, and around_query keeping both comparison-table rows. Acceptance read-range now passes --seq and --query together.
summary.why: Issue #101 item 1 already shipped in 0.4.4. Item 2 was the remaining eval gap: context budget only lived in eval:perf aggregates. Item 3 asked for reusable public eval material so future ranking work does not depend on private goldens. Unit tests already covered the shapes; the gate did not.

decisions.point: Whether items 2 and 3 were still worth doing
decisions.chose: Yes, but small: observational context-size metric plus two public acceptance mirrors. No CLI release.
decisions.rationale: These prevent silent elision/ranking regressions and make the private dogfood shapes reviewable in CI. A new CLI version would publish nothing users run.
rejected: Building a large public FP/FN corpus
Gating hard-fail on context byte budgets

decisions.chose: Per-row returnedContext plus a batch summary on dogfood/acceptance scorecards
decisions.rationale: Issue 101 asked for per-case visibility, not another bench-only column. eval:perf already has output bytes.
rejected: Adding expected.context.maxChars as a blocking assertion in this pass

rejected.alternative: Diversity reranker or relaxed recall for leftover D cases
rejected.reason: Already rejected in int_071015d2 / int_d189e8a1 / int_1136bd41. Those goldens were marked stale in 0.4.4.

acknowledged_constraints.note: No diversity reranker; only public mirrors and metrics
Did not hardcode query/session ids in ranking; acceptance fixtures are synthetic

review_notes: No package.json bump. Eval is not in the published npm package.

architectural_claims: Returned-context size is a standing dogfood/acceptance scorecard metric, not only an eval:perf bench column.
Public acceptance fixtures may mirror private dogfood FP/FN shapes without copying private transcripts.
behavioral_changes: Acceptance and dogfood scorecards emit returnedContext per case and a batch p50/p95 summary.
Acceptance read-range keeps --query next to --seq so around_query can preserve evidence.
Acceptance gate includes command-restatement-loses-to-execution and query-window-keeps-table-rows as hard cases.
